decisions.reason: {{NRDB species |genus=Heterodactylus |species=lundii |accessdate=27 July 2019}} is the whole body of ref RDB. Its purpose is to format a citation to a Reptile Database entry; the rendered footnote reads 'Heterodactylus lundii at the Reptarium.cz Reptile Database. Accessed 27 July 2019.' That is a citation template under 3.1 ('whose purpose is to format a citation ... and similar'). The locked d2 template list is right and the engine missed it. Ambiguity: the guide does not name this template; the purpose-based wording decides it.
